item.value: training stops if the total validation loss (loss on the data plus regularization loss) does not improve for 50 epochs. Once training has stopped, we reset the state of the weights to the step with the lowest validation loss.
item.quote: We train for a maximum of 100 k epochs. However, the actual training time is considerably shorter since we use strict early stopping. Specifically, with our unified early stopping criterion training stops if the total validation loss (loss on the data plus regularization loss) does not improve for 50 epochs. Once training has stopped, we reset the state of the weights to the step with the lowest validation loss.
